sbar.situation: Clearing is back up and payments are flowing again. Two recovery checks in a row were clean, the last at 25 s.
sbar.background: The clearing worker crashed on malformed queue item 90 with 'JSONDecodeError: Expecting property name enclosed in double quotes' in parse(item). It exited and stopped answering, so payments stayed pending and the clearing backlog grew.
sbar.assessment: The root cause was a poison message on clearing (confidence 0.8). The incident commander quarantined item 90, which succeeded and set it aside for the operations team. It then restarted clearing, which also succeeded. The screening-standby restarts are routine and carry no traffic.
sbar.recommendation: Watch the clearing backlog and confirm that payments held during the outage have cleared. This was escalated (soon) to the operations team, who must review item 90 and either repair and resubmit it or close it with its customer.
